title: A comment @mention writes one Inbox row for the person mentioned and none for the writer; marking it read drops the unread count; turning a group's email off stops only the email; the join-requests group cannot be turned off
steps: S0: Common setup (tests/regression/README.md). Site S = the WordPress test site (scv2wp.<stand domain>), P = its page origin as its comments carry it. Read B's account id: pq "select id from account where email = 'scv2-b@example.test'" → BID. Read both unread counts: api a GET /api/notifications/unread → UA0; api b GET /api/notifications/unread → UB0.
S1: api b GET /api/notifications/preferences and keep the whole groups list as PREF0 (to restore in S6).
S2: api a POST /api/sites/$S/comments '{"text":"[REG-053] @b one","url":"$P/","element":null,"mentions":["BID"]}' → keep comment.id as C1.

S3: api b GET /api/notifications → find the row with kind 'comment.mention' and siteKey S created after S0, keep its id as N1. api a GET /api/notifications/unread → UA1. api b GET /api/notifications/unread → UB1. pq "select mail_state from notification where id = 'N1'" → M1.
S4: api b POST /api/notifications/N1/read; api b GET /api/notifications/unread → UB2.

S5: api b PUT /api/notifications/preferences '{"groups":{"mentions-replies":{"inbox":true,"email":false}}}'. api a POST /api/sites/$S/comments '{"text":"[REG-053] @b two","url":"$P/","element":null,"mentions":["BID"]}' → C2. api b GET /api/notifications → the newest comment.mention row on S, id N2. pq "select mail_state, in_inbox from notification where id = 'N2'" → M2. Then api b PUT /api/notifications/preferences '{"groups":{"join-requests":{"inbox":false,"email":false}}}' and read the answer's join-requests group → J.

S6: Clean up: put back PREF0 for every group B changed (api b PUT /api/notifications/preferences with PREF0's inbox/email for mentions-replies). api a POST /api/sites/$S/comments/clear '{"ids":["C1","C2"]}'.
expect: S3: exactly one new comment.mention row for B on S with actor = seat a, readAt null; UB1 = UB0 + 1; UA1 = UA0 (the writer gets nothing); M1 is 'pending' or 'sent'.
S5: N2 exists in B's Inbox (in_inbox true) and M2 is 'none' (the email channel is off, the Inbox channel is not); J reads inbox true and email true (the locked group did not change).
evidence: Spec #809: before it, a person mentioned in a comment, replied to or removed from a site was told nothing. ADR 0026.
fence: The server writes one row per recipient at the door that caused the event (never the writer, rule R2); a group's channel switch stops only that channel; the join-requests group is locked on
